QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Lush Forest
QuestInfo.0: You arrived in a lush forest after passing through the #bBroken Gate of Time#k. Is this the past? See if anyone can confirm where...or when...you are.
QuestInfo.1: Yuris looked perfectly normal, but the more you talk to her, the stranger she seems. Maybe you should find someone easier to talk to. Try that #e#bLoha#k#n person whom Yuris mentioned.
QuestInfo.2: Who is Kao? Everyone keeps mentioning that name...

0.0: Okay, tighten this screw, fix this... Oh, I just can't concentrate. Lemme think, lemme think...\r\n#L0##bEr, excuse me... This is my first time here. Where am I?#l\n#k
0.1: Oh! ...That wasn't the problem at all! So, maybe if I fix this... Reconnect this to here... *Mumble mumble*\r\n#L0##b(Maybe she didn't hear you...) Um, excuse me...#l\n#k
0.2: Eh? Oh, hey there, Kao. When did you get here?\r\n#L0##b(...Kao? What is she talking about...?) I just... I mean...#l\n#k
0.3: Hey, Loha's been looking for you. She looked pretty upset, so you'd better go find her.\r\n#L0##b(Loha? Who's that? This person isn't making any sense. Maybe if you talk to Loha, you can get some answers.) Right...where can I find Loha?#l\n#k
0.4: What's wrong with you, Kao? #eLoha#n is in front of the #bClinic at the Camp#k. You know that. Now, get going. I am so busy...

yes.0: You should hurry. Come to think of it, Loha's been looking for you for awhile. I've been so focused on fixing this thing, I lost track of time...

no.0: What? You're not going to go see Loha? Or are you trying to convince me that there's nothing wrong with you? Whatever.

1.0: Kao! Where have you been?\r\n#L0##b(Again with the Kao... What's going on?) I, um, I came because Yuris told me...#l\n#k
1.1: One second. Let me finish this first!

npc.0: You haven't gone to see Loha? Hurry up! She's in front of the Clinic at Altaire Camp.
